goal: Partner inbox no seeding in production
summary: Eliminated synthetic inquiry fallback and seeding in production partner inboxes across client and API boundaries. In frontend/src/lib/rbpc/inquiries.ts, fetchPartnerInquiries now preserves live empty lists ([]) and re-throws errors rather than falling back to SEED_PARTNER_INQUIRIES unless explicitly in demo mode. In frontend/src/app/rbpc/partner/page.tsx, inquiries state initializes to [] and strictly reflects live tenant records, displaying a clean empty state ('Chưa có yêu cầu trải nghiệm nào') when 0 inquiries exist and presenting an explicit error alert on failure. Seed data is strictly restricted to unauthenticated preview/demo mode labeled with a DEMO DATA banner.

root_causes_addressed.inquiries_service_fallback: fetchPartnerInquiries previously caught errors or empty responses and returned SEED_PARTNER_INQUIRIES.
root_causes_addressed.partner_page_state_initialization: PartnerDashboardContent initialized inquiries state with SEED_PARTNER_INQUIRIES and had ternary fallback items && items.length > 0 ? items : SEED_PARTNER_INQUIRIES.
root_causes_addressed.silent_error_masking: API errors previously resulted in silent substitution with synthetic records.

error_behavior.default: Re-throws ApiError / Error to caller so error UI alerts can be presented
error_behavior.demo_mode: Returns SEED_PARTNER_INQUIRIES only when options.allowDemoFallback is true

production_live_tenant.banner: LIVE TENANT (Chế độ sản xuất: Không gian người thuê được bảo vệ nghiêm ngặt)
production_live_tenant.empty_state_text: Chưa có yêu cầu trải nghiệm nào

preview_demo_mode.banner: DEMO DATA (Chế độ xem trước tính năng)
